name: ETL/ELT
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)

beginner.summary: For analysts, developers and database administrators who know basic SQL and Python and are new to building data pipelines. Covers the extract, transform and load stages, the difference between ETL and ELT, extraction from APIs, databases and files, full and incremental loads, staging layers, transformations in pandas, Polars and SQL, upserts with MERGE, idempotent re-runs, data types and time zones, reject handling, basic data quality checks, scheduling, secrets, pipeline tests, and a capstone that loads retail orders from an API and CSV files into DuckDB.
prerequisites: Writes SELECT queries with joins and GROUP BY and runs Python 3.11 or later scripts with pip and virtual environments
Uses a terminal and Git for basic tasks such as cloning a repository and committing a file
Has a laptop with Python, Docker Desktop (or Podman) and rights to install packages such as duckdb, polars, pandas and requests
outcomes: Explain ETL and ELT trade-offs and choose a load pattern (full, incremental or upsert) for a given source
Build a Python and SQL pipeline that extracts from an API, a database and files, stages the raw data and loads a curated table without duplicates
Make a pipeline safe to re-run by using idempotent writes, reject tables and run metadata
Test and schedule a pipeline with pytest, cron and environment-based configuration
